Patna’s construction boom — highway projects, riverfront development, new institutions, and the Bihta industrial corridor — drives steady demand for site offices, security cabins, and worker accommodation. SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd manufactures IS 2062 MS-frame porta cabins at our Greater Noida factory and dispatches them to Patna in 3 to 5 days via the Purvanchal / NH-19 corridor. For Patna’s heavy monsoon and low-lying river-plain sites we build with raised plinths and sealed roofing as standard. For a porta cabin in Patna, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937 for specifications and a price.

Why Patna Buyers Choose SAMAN

The porta cabin results a Patna buyer finds online are mostly IndiaMART and TradeIndia directories — and many “Patna” listings actually redirect to national supplier pages with no Bihar-specific information at all. For Patna’s monsoon-prone, river-plain sites, that generic approach misses what matters.

SAMAN is the manufacturer. Call us and you reach the team that builds the cabin. Every unit leaves our factory with:

  • IS 2062 Grade A MS hollow-section frame, zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated
  • 50 mm PUF sandwich panels with factory-sealed joints
  • Colour-coated GI roof with proper drainage slope for Patna’s heavy monsoon
  • Pre-wired MCB board with ELCB earthing

We hold ISO 9001:2015 (E20250218645), ISO 14001:2015 (E20250218646), and ISO 45001:2018 (E20250218647), plus NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition. Started 2009, incorporated 2019 as SAMAN POS India Pvt Ltd (POS = Portable Office Solutions). 500+ projects delivered across India.

Delivery: ₹3,000 standard. Transit to Patna: 3–5 days from Greater Noida. Returns: 7 days, return freight at buyer’s cost.

Patna’s Construction and Industrial Demand

Patna’s growth as Bihar’s capital and a major infrastructure-investment centre creates several distinct sources of porta cabin demand:

Patliputra Industrial Area (PIN 800013): Patna’s established industrial estate — food processing, packaging, light engineering, and small manufacturing. Security cabins at plot entries and portable offices are the common requirements.

Bihta industrial area (PIN 801103): A fast-growing industrial and institutional zone west of Patna, home to major institutions and new manufacturing. Greenfield construction here generates multi-room contractor offices and labour accommodation demand.

Fatuha industrial area (PIN 803201): Manufacturing and logistics units east of the city. Plant gate security cabins and portable site offices are typical.

Infrastructure and construction: Patna is one of India’s most active infrastructure markets — Ganga riverfront development, new bridges (including the Mahatma Gandhi Setu and additional Ganga crossings), metro rail construction, highway upgrades, and large institutional and housing projects. These generate strong, recurring demand for contractor site offices and labour colony blocks.

Logistics: Patna’s position on the eastern logistics network drives warehouse and distribution-centre construction that uses porta cabins as gate and site offices.

We dispatch from Greater Noida via the Agra-Lucknow Expressway and Purvanchal Expressway / NH-19 corridor — bringing cabins to Patna in 3–5 days. Patna sits within our eastern India dispatch belt, the same factory-direct service behind our porta cabin in Kolkata and porta cabin in Bhubaneswar deliveries.

Porta Cabin Specifications — Built for Patna’s Monsoon

Patna sits on the Ganga plain, with heavy monsoon rainfall and many low-lying, flood-prone sites. Every cabin is specified for these conditions.

Frame: IS 2062 Grade A mild steel hollow sections. Welded, zinc-phosphate primed, powder-coated, anchor-bolted to an RCC plinth.

Panels: 50 mm PUF sandwich panels standard. Cement-board panels available for longer-term outdoor use.

Roofing: Colour-coated GI sheet with a controlled drainage slope and internal false ceiling. Factory-sealed joints keep the cabin watertight through the monsoon.

Flooring: Anti-skid chequered MS plate or commercial-grade laminate. For low-lying and flood-prone Patna sites we strongly recommend a raised RCC plinth, or elevated flooring on MS joists, to keep the floor above waterlogging.

Doors and windows: MS frame, powder-coat finish, louvre or sliding windows; fixed glazing on request. All factory-fitted.

Electrical: Pre-wired MCB board, 2–4 power points per room, tube-light provision, ELCB.

Standard sizes: 8×10 ft · 10×12 ft · 10×20 ft · 10×30 ft · 10×40 ft · custom sizes accepted.

Configurations: single room, two-room, multi-room block, with attached toilet/washroom, with pantry.

Applications in Patna

  • Contractor site offices at Ganga bridge, metro rail, and highway projects
  • Labour accommodation blocks at large infrastructure and housing projects
  • Security cabins at Patliputra, Bihta, and Fatuha industrial plot entries
  • Site-management offices at riverfront and institutional construction
  • Portable stores for tools and materials at project yards
  • Supervisor offices at warehouse and logistics-centre construction

Customisation Options

  • Custom dimensions and multi-room layouts
  • Raised RCC plinth or elevated MS-joist flooring for flood-prone sites (recommended for low-lying Patna locations)
  • RAL colour choice
  • Air-conditioning provision (wall-sleeve cut-out + power point)
  • Turbo ventilator and false ceiling for summer heat
  • Internal partitions, extra doors/windows
  • Plumbing for attached toilet or washroom
  • Two-storey stacking where load calculations allow

Share your site location and conditions; we confirm specification and price at quotation stage.

Porta Cabin Price in Patna — Cost Factors

  1. Size — 8×10 ft single room is entry-level; 10×40 ft block is the upper end.
  2. Panel choice — PUF (standard) vs cement-board.
  3. Site additions — raised plinth or elevated flooring for flood-prone sites.
  4. Fit-out — bare shell vs fully fitted (electrical, flooring, paint, AC).
  5. Quantity — 5+ units attract better per-unit pricing. Confirm at quotation.

For an accurate porta cabin price in Patna for your size and site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937.

Delivery and Installation in Patna

We dispatch from Greater Noida (Vill Jalpura, Tehsil Dadri, UP 201308) via the Agra-Lucknow and Purvanchal / NH-19 corridor on flatbed trucks. Transit: 3–5 days. We arrange dispatch from our North India factory and onward to Patna on a factory-direct basis. On arrival the cabin is set on your pre-cast RCC plinth — raised where the site needs it — anchor-bolted, panels checked, and the MCB board connected. A single-room cabin is ready within hours; a multi-room block in about a day. Delivery: ₹3,000 standard; confirm consolidated rate for multiple cabins. We have no Patna warehouse or branch — every cabin is built to order and delivered direct to your site.

Frequently Asked Questions — Porta Cabin in Patna

Does SAMAN deliver porta cabins to Bihta, Patliputra, and Fatuha?

Yes. We deliver across Patna — Patliputra Industrial Area, Bihta, and Fatuha — and to construction sites across the Patna region. Transit from our Greater Noida factory is 3–5 days. Delivery charge is ₹3,000 standard.

How does a SAMAN porta cabin handle Patna’s monsoon and flood-prone sites?

Panel joints are factory-sealed and the GI roof has a controlled drainage slope so rain runs off cleanly. For low-lying and flood-prone Patna sites we recommend a raised RCC plinth or elevated flooring on MS joists to keep the floor above waterlogging. The MS frame is zinc-phosphate primed and powder-coated to resist rust through Bihar’s long wet season.

What is the price of a porta cabin in Patna?

Price depends on size, panel type, fit-out level, and site additions such as a raised plinth. Call +91 87960 39938 or send an enquiry for a quotation built for your site and specification. We do not publish fixed prices because every cabin is built to order.

Can SAMAN supply porta cabins for a Patna bridge, metro, or government infrastructure project?

Yes. We supply infrastructure project managers and government contractors. Our NSIC (NSIC/GP/BAN/2024/0055207) and DPIIT (DIPP56005) recognition, ISO certificates, GST registration, and incorporation documents are available for vendor empanelment. Share your project scope and we will confirm supply capacity and timeline.

How long does delivery from the factory to Patna take?

3–5 days from our Greater Noida factory via the Purvanchal / NH-19 corridor, after production is complete. Production lead time depends on your configuration and the order queue — confirm at enquiry. Standard sizes move faster.

Get a Porta Cabin in Patna

For a porta cabin in Patna delivered to your industrial plot, bridge or metro project, or construction site, call +91 87960 39938 or +91 97089 89937, or send an enquiry using the form below. We will respond with the right specification for Patna’s monsoon conditions, a delivery timeline, and a firm quotation. Explore our configurable porta cabin site units for the full range of sizes, configurations, and build options.
